title: 第7章 这个世界第8章 团队
lines: 第7章这个世界
万雄！
在整个飞仙星都小有名气的一个高中生。
虽然只是高三的学生，但灵力值却已经达到了两百零三！
迈入七级战士门槛！
一个十九岁的高级战士！
灵力值一百三十五的司音是灵战士中的天才，万雄同样毫不逊色。
灵战士虽然不像符篆师那么稀罕，但能在这个年龄就拥有这么高灵力值的人，在整个百城也是不多见。
万雄不仅仅是灵力值高，他的武技也相当厉害，综合实力极强。
就像王良说的那样，灵力值，只是灵战士的基础。
除此之外，武技的品阶和属性、身体素质和心理素质的强弱、战斗经验丰富与否，都会影响一个人的综合实力。
万雄从高一开始，便带队参加的百市的各种比赛，每次都是第一，所向披靡！
今年春天代表百城参加飞仙星高中生联赛，更是如同一匹黑马，在两千多支队伍中脱颖而出！
一路横扫，击败无数团队，甚至大量高三团队都在他面前折戟沉沙！
最终获得了第九名的逆天成绩！
打到最后，几乎是万雄一个人扛着整个团队在前进！
如果当时队伍中有一个出色的符篆师，那么他们的名次甚至可能会更好。
而这，已经是百城有史以来的最好成绩了！
这种名次，在高考的时候至少可以加三十分！
如今距离高考还有一年，已经有十几所飞仙星名校看好他，直接发来面试邀请。
只要通过面试，便可免试入学。
他的未来，不可限量！
不过有传言说万雄并不想在飞仙上大学，他的目标，是祖龙帝国更高级的那些顶级学院！
所以哪怕是刚刚入校的高一学生，对万雄的名字，也都如雷贯耳。
现在这样一个传说中的学长，竟然出现在他们班级，亲自来找穆锡。
有些震撼到了这群新嫩菜鸟们！
穆锡也是微微一怔，不过在感受到那些目光时，他的脸上露出矜持笑容。
站起身道：“万雄学长，我就是穆锡。”
这种感觉，非常爽！
一扫之前被人无视的郁闷！
“我来找你，是想要邀请你进入我的队伍，跟我一起打比赛。”万雄微笑看着穆锡说道。
“邀请我？”穆锡有些惊讶。
班级里的学生也都是一脸震撼，高三的学长，跑来邀请高一的新生加入自己的队伍？
事实上这种现象在每一届符篆师班出现的时候都很常见。
尤其是精神力高的学生，更加抢手。
在强者眼中，初级符篆师或许没什么太大作用，但对于校园这个级别来说，初级的符篆师，就已经很强了！
一个优秀的初级符篆师，在比赛中跟队友配合默契的话，能够发挥出难以想象的巨大作用。
甚至可以拥有掌控比赛的能力！
比如在战斗的关键时刻，一张控制符篆砸向对手，哪怕只能让对方停顿一秒钟，也足以分出胜负！
万雄微笑道：“是的，我想邀请你加入我的队伍，跟着高三的队伍一起参加比赛，你会得到更多的见识，也会……”
“我答应！”

Chapter 7 This World
Wan Xiong!
A high school student who is famous throughout Feixianxing.
Although he is only a senior high school student, his spiritual power value has already reached 203!
Entering the threshold of seventh-level warrior!
A nineteen-year-old senior warrior!
Si Yin, who has a spiritual power value of 135, is a genius among spiritual warriors, and Wan Xiong is no less talented.
Although spiritual warriors are not as rare as talisman masters, people with such high spiritual power at this age are rare in the entire Hundred Cities.
Wan Xiong not only has high spiritual power, but his martial arts are also quite powerful, and his overall strength is extremely strong.
Just like Wang Liang said, spiritual power is only the foundation of a spiritual warrior.
In addition, the level and attributes of martial arts, the strength of physical and mental qualities, and rich combat experience will all affect a person's overall strength.
Wan Xiong has led his team to participate in various competitions in hundreds of cities since he was a freshman in high school, ranking first every time and invincible!
This spring, he represented Baicheng in the Feixianxing High School League, and he was like a dark horse, standing out among more than 2,000 teams!
Sweeping all the way, defeating countless teams, even a large number of senior high school teams collapsed in front of him!
In the end, he achieved an incredible result of ninth place!
At the end of the fight, it was almost Wan Xiong who was carrying the entire team forward!
If there was an outstanding Talisman Master in the team at that time, their ranking might even be better.
And this is already the best result in the history of Baicheng!
This kind of ranking can add at least thirty points in the college entrance examination!
Now that there is still one year left before the college entrance examination, more than a dozen prestigious Feixianxing schools have taken a fancy to him and directly sent him invitations for interviews.
As long as you pass the interview, you can enroll without taking the exam.
His future is limitless!
However, there are rumors that Wan Xiong does not want to go to college in Feixian. His goal is to go to the top colleges in the Zulong Empire!
Therefore, even the first-year high school students who have just entered the school are familiar with Wan Xiong's name.
Now such a legendary senior appeared in their class and came to see Mu Xi personally.
This group of newbies was somewhat shocked!
Mu Xi was also slightly startled, but when he felt those gazes, a reserved smile appeared on his face.
He stood up and said, "Senior Wan Xiong, I am Mu Xi."
This feeling is very refreshing!
Get rid of the depression of being ignored before!
"I came to you because I want to invite you to join my team and play games with me." Wan Xiong looked at Mu Xi with a smile and said.
"Invite me?" Mu Xi was a little surprised.
The students in the class also looked shocked. Seniors from the senior year of high school came to invite the freshmen from the first year of high school to join their team?
In fact, this phenomenon is very common in every talisman and seal master class.
Especially students with high mental strength are more in demand.
In the eyes of the strong, a junior Talisman Seal Master may not be of much use, but for the campus level, a junior Talisman Seal Master is already very powerful!
An excellent junior Talisman Seal Master can play an unimaginable role if he cooperates with his teammates during the game.
You can even have the ability to control the game!
For example, at a critical moment in the battle, if a control talisman is thrown at the opponent, even if it can only make the opponent pause for a second, it is enough to determine the winner!
Wan Xiong smiled and said: "Yes, I would like to invite you to join my team and participate in the competition with the senior high school team. You will gain more insights and also..."
"I promise!"
